notes.roughness: ms_d2_z is the per-map mean square entering common.fit's penalty term (smooth * mean(...)); rms = its square root. restricted_extra: second differences with all three cells in z'-bin centres [20, 1150] mm and rings 0-30
notes.formula: formula = WithAcceptance(core, A_bar): its ln P includes ln A_bar (template with front and back faces, floored at 1e-6)
notes.window: the specified window includes z' < 0, where on the inner rings both maps are almost empty (see inner_rings_z_lt_0); Delta there is a step of tens of nat at z' ~ 0
